checks.evidence: languages/python/benchmarks/linters/ruff/Cargo.toml:1-49 makes the Ruff benchmark its own unpublished package, and 8221fa41c9 moved the four engine, SDK and provider proofs it held to their owning crates. What stays there (engine_test/authored_queries_test.rs:5) validates the benchmark's own authored queries through the public SDK. It asserts no engine contract. The port-suite seam suite lives in crates/execution/tests.

ci/scripts/checks/sdk_api.py:30 sets INTERNAL to ryo_core, ryo_language, ryo_relations, ryo_values and ryo_query_language. The SDK also depends directly on ryo_execution, ryo_execution_runtime, ryo_operators and ryo_matching (crates/sdk/Cargo.toml:18-23), and through them reaches execution_domain, execution_store and derived types. leaks() (sdk_api.py:128) filters on INTERNAL. Probe: one public SDK function returning a foreign type. Defined in ryo_core it reports 1 leak; defined in ryo_execution_runtime, ryo_execution, ryo_operators or ryo_matching it reports 0. So the sdk-api gate (in this diff's closure: audit-f3 changed it to --all-features) passes an SDK that leaks an execution, operator or matching type once its listing is re-recorded. The other plants fired: the RelationStore seal and the fixtures gate across crates (execution_runtime, CLI default build), unused_must_use and unfulfilled_lint_expectations each 1. The seven merge resolutions were read: none dropped a guard.

No normal or build dependency in any crates/ryo manifest enables fixtures or a test feature (manifest scan over every git-tracked Cargo.toml). Plants, each reverted: (a) execution_runtime implementing the store's sealed::Sealed fails E0603 (relations/interface.rs:16). (b) execution_runtime production code calling RelationOwner::fixture fails E0599 (relations.rs:167 is gated). (c) the CLI library (default features, all languages) re-exporting core's lint fixtures fails E0432. The SDK checks under --no-default-features and --all-features. crates/sdk/api.txt names no ryo_execution*, ryo_operators, ryo_matching or ryo_derived type. The ryo_language and ryo_relations types it lists sit under ryo::languages or are re-exported there (checked: ByteSlice, Reading, SampleText, Oracle, Shape, SourcePath, ReadItem, CellKind).

Cargo.lock gains only the internal ruff benchmark package. Item 6: no copied representation found across the merged branches.
